shortDescription: Рассчитайте рост вложений со сложными процентами: итоговая сумма, взносы и начисленные проценты.

inputs.helpText: How often interest is calculated and added to your investment

examples.title: Пример 1
examples.description: $10,000 initial investment, $200 monthly contributions, 7% annual interest rate, 20 years, monthly compounding
examples.resultDescription: After 20 years of investing $10,000 initially and $200 monthly at 7% annual interest with monthly compounding, your investment grows to approximately $128,000. You contributed $58,000 total and earned about $70,000 in interest, demonstrating the power of compound interest over time. For more detailed investment analysis, try the Investment Calculator.

examples.title: Пример 2
examples.description: $0 initial investment, $300 monthly contributions, 5% annual interest rate, 10 years, monthly compounding
examples.resultDescription: Starting with $0 and contributing $300 monthly for 10 years at 5% annual interest with monthly compounding results in approximately $46,500. You contributed $36,000 and earned about $10,500 in interest, showing how consistent small contributions can grow significantly over time.

faq.question: Насколько точен расчёт?
faq.answer: Калькулятор использует стандартные финансовые формулы. Реальные условия банка или брокера могут отличаться.

faq.question: В какой валюте считаются суммы?
faq.answer: Подписи показывают рубли (₽); формула универсальна для любой валюты при согласованных единицах.
